Plats: Stockholm (hybrid, 2-3 dagar per vecka på kontoret)
Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Omgående
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning
Om rollen
Vi söker en driven och tekniskt skicklig Security Engineer / Security Operations Consultant som vill vara med och stärka säkerhetsarbetet i en modern och molnbaserad verksamhet.
I rollen kommer du att arbeta nära IT- och säkerhetsorganisationen med fokus på incidenthantering, säkerhetsövervakning, sårbarhetshantering och vidareutveckling av företagets säkerhetsplattformar. Du kommer att få stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både operativa och strategiska säkerhetsinitiativ.
Vi söker en person som trivs med att arbeta hands-on, tar ägarskap och kan driva säkerhetsarbetet framåt självständigt.
Arbetsuppgifter
Som Security Engineer kommer du bland annat att:
Övervaka och hantera säkerhetslarm och incidenter
Genomföra incidentutredningar och koordinera åtgärder
Identifiera rotorsaker och implementera långsiktiga lösningar
Arbeta med sårbarhetshantering och riskreducerande aktiviteter
Vidareutveckla och förvalta säkerhetsverktyg och plattformar
Stödja säkerhetsarbetet i molnmiljöer
Samarbeta med interna intressenter kring säkerhetsförbättringar
Bidra till utvecklingen av processer och arbetssätt inom Security Operations
Delta i säkerhetsrelaterade projekt och förbättringsinitiativ

Vi söker dig som
Har erfarenhet från Security Operations, Security Engineering eller Cloud Security
Har arbetat med incident response och operativt sä

description.text:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.
 


Your role

We are expanding our Information & Cyber Security Organization within Business Area Surveillance and are looking for a strategic leader to head our Protective Security team. This role is key to bridging security governance and operational excellence, ensuring security remains both a requirement and a competitive advantage for Saab.
As Information Security Manager for the Protective Security team, you will lead specialists responsible for governance and oversight of our most critical security frameworks. The team ensures compliance with strict protective security requirements, combining technical IT security with legislative obligations in an international and highly regulated environment.
 
Your main tasks will be:
Ensure legislative compliance by leading the implementation of the Swedish Protective Security Act and Ordinance within Information and IT Security.
Drive the protective security framework by defining and overseeing security standards, baselines, and requirements.
Guide risk assessments and threat analyses, ensuring effective mitigation strategies aligned with business needs.
Establish processes to monitor and validate security measures, ensuring resilience against evolving threats.

 
Preferred locations for this role are Solna/Stockholm or Kallebäck/Göteborg.

Job Description
Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
